notes.title: Yung Venuz Plushie
notes.content: [h1]Yung Venuz Plushie[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5197250/ffe15f3cf3c4dff29b9ab0e1e5416c91a15351f7.png"][/img][/p][p]We just launched a [url="https://www.makeship.com/petitions/yv-plushie"]Makeship Petition[/url] to summon your favorite dead body looting mutant shooting triangular gun god! Now 100% more huggable, including the cutest stack of cash you've ever seen.	 [/p][p][/p][p]Key stats:[/p][list][*][p]The original Gun God. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Including a fat stack of cash, valued at approximately 1000000 Venusian mony. 	[/p][/*][*][p]Triangle (the best shape) 	[/p][/*][*][p] Passive ability: Higher Rate of Fire.[/p][/*][*][p]As seen in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/242680/Nuclear_Throne/"]Nuclear Throne[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/522940/GUN_GODZ/"]Gun Godz[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Yung Venuz is cool.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26886360/f9a69c01adbe1a4589acfc2176be0e121a9b4c36.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're gonna need at least 200 pledges to help bring this Y.V. plushie into existence, so please tell your friends and [url="https://www.makeship.com/petitions/yv-plushie"]head over to the campaign[/url]![/p]
